BUSINESS IT SERVICES

Business connectivity and cloud telephony.

Business connectivity and telephony projects connect premises, people and customer conversations. HeyDock can scope requirements and coordinate suitable broadband, leased-line, mobile connectivity and cloud-phone options. Supplier availability, contracts, installation dates and service responsibilities are confirmed before any order.

Discuss requirementsExplore services

SERVICE EXPLAINED

What does this service involve?

An internet or telephone change affects more than a monthly bill. Consider application use, voice quality, resilience, number ownership and how users will work during migration. A supplier delivery date is not the same as a fully tested business-ready service.

The engagement starts by identifying the business outcome, existing responsibilities and the changes you authorise. HeyDock then confirms suitable delivery capacity, the working window and the evidence needed to complete the task. Related licences, hardware, subscriptions and specialist services are included only where the proposal says so.

PRACTICAL SCOPE

What can be included?

The final statement of work identifies the tasks that apply to your environment.

Connectivity requirements

Review sites, users, applications, upload needs and resilience. Compare available access types against the actual location and business requirements instead of assuming the same service is available everywhere.

Cloud phones and contact workflows

Map numbers, call routing, users, devices and customer support requirements. Number porting, emergency calling arrangements and licensing need specific attention in the selected service.

Cutover and supplier coordination

Agree the install schedule, migration sequence, testing and fallback. Identify which organisation owns the circuit or platform and where faults will be escalated.

EXAMPLE REQUIREMENT

How a project might work.

An office move may need a temporary connection while a permanent service is installed. The project plan should test the fallback against real application and calling needs before the move date.

PLANNING AND COST

What affects the scope and price?

Cost depends on the number of users, devices or sites; technical complexity; access requirements; delivery hours; travel; and the work needed before and after implementation. Provide relevant system versions and existing supplier responsibilities so the quotation can distinguish labour from licences, equipment and recurring charges.

For a well-defined task, a visit or project quotation may be appropriate. Where important dependencies are unknown, a paid assessment can produce a better implementation scope. Any response, attendance or recovery target must be explicitly agreed; requesting a service does not create an immediate support commitment.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Business connectivity and cloud telephony FAQs

Do you operate a telecom network?+

No network-operator status is claimed. Service availability and supply arrangements are established through the relevant providers.

Can you help with business mobiles and SIM requirements?+

Mobile connectivity, device and SIM requirements can be assessed as part of a scoped connectivity project.

What information should we include in an enquiry?+

Describe the objective, location, affected systems, preferred timing and existing support arrangements. Do not send passwords or sensitive business records in the enquiry form.
